Games/CelticsatBucks
Celtics 117Bucks 97

George and Tatum lead Boston past Milwaukee

Final · Sun, Nov 8 · Milwaukee

George scored 27 and Tatum 21. Boston led by as many as 23.

▶ Jump to the play

1 · What happened

The game, in 5 parts.

THE STORY · SCROLL
1 of 5 · First half

How it started.

The Bucks led 27–25 after one quarter. At the half, the Celtics led 58–45.

2 of 5 · The difference

George: 27 points on 11-of-18 shooting

5 of 10 from three, with 2 steals.

3 of 5 · How it turned

Won the second quarter 33–18

Down 2 after one quarter, the Celtics won the second quarter 33–18 to lead 58–45. George and Tatum combined for 48 of 117.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it inside and on the glass

Points in the paint 44–28; rebounds 48–36. Five Celtics scored in double figures.

5 of 5 · Final

Celtics 117, Bucks 97.

From the Bucks’ side: Lost the second quarter 18–33, the stretch that decided it.

What it meant: Celtics 10–2, 1st in the East, 99% top-6 odds. Bucks 1–11, 15th in the East, 0%.

The go-ahead three.
